description: List everything a MapMap style theme can style: the first-party named bases a style can start from (pass one as `create_style`'s `base`, or as the static-map API's `style=`), the named palette slots with their light/dark default colours, the skeleton layer ids (paint order) that `set_layer_paint` accepts, the OpenMapTiles source-layers extra layers may reference, the insertion slots (`bottom`, `middle`, `top`) an extra layer may name, and the rules for a theme's own `sources` (your data by https URL). Attribution is enforced on every compiled style and cannot be themed away. Local lookup, no network; always works.
name: list_style_layers

PaletteSlotInfo.description: One themable palette slot with its built-in light/dark defaults.

dark.description: Default colour on the dark base theme.

light.description: Default colour on the light base theme.

StyleBaseInfo.description: One entry in the named-base catalogue (`sn_style::list_bases`).

description.description: One line saying what the base is for. This is what to choose on.

group.description:
"base" for the two stock slates (`light`, `dark`), "designed" for a
drawn style.

id.description:
Base id: what `create_style`'s `base` and the static-map API's
`style=` accept, e.g. "navigator-night".

restrictions.description:
True when the base is drawn to sit under MapMap's
vehicle-restriction overlay (only `fleet`). That overlay is a
mapmap.ai runtime layer, not tile data and not part of any compiled
style, so it draws in Studio and on /map and nowhere else. Asking
for this base anywhere else gets the palette alone; for a real
restriction answer use `check_clearance_on_route` or
`check_adr_tunnel`, which answer for an actual vehicle.

StyleSlotInfo.description: One insertion slot for extra layers (Mapbox Standard names).

before.description: The skeleton layer id the slot sits directly below.

max_geojson_sources.description: At most this many of them `geojson`.

max_sources.description: At most this many sources per theme.

url_rules.description: The URL rules every source URL must pass.

attribution.description:
The attribution contract: enforced on every compiled style, not
themable.

bases.description:
The first-party named bases a style can start from, in display
order: pass one to `create_style`'s `base`, or to the static-map
API's `style=`.

layer_ids.description:
The skeleton layer ids a theme's `layers` may override, in paint
order (first = bottom).

palette_slots.description:
The named palette slots a theme's `palette` may override, with
their light/dark defaults, in presentation order.

slots.description:
The insertion slots an extra layer may name (`"slot"`), bottom of
the stack first, with the layer each sits directly below. A layer
without a slot goes in `middle`.

source_layers.description:
The OpenMapTiles source-layers the tiles emit; an extra layer on
the `territory` source must reference one of these.

sources.description: The rules for a theme's own `sources` (customer data by URL).
